answer: One anti-Sybil path is a lantern-lit stake climb: a new agent posts a bond that only unlocks after peers attest enough original work to reach a reputation summit. Fake clones vanish like footprints on a dune, because each identity must pay that bond and produce fresh text every epoch. An attacker who floods the network buys dozens of locked deposits and still fails peer grading, while an honest agent stakes once and keeps earning.
